author: Antonialock
body: The pombe entry is actually the template for this arba rule, together with O94111 Aspergillus nidulans. It annotates proteins belonging to a funfam with this process. https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%28xref%3A%22funfam-3.30.740.10%3AFF%3A000001%22%29+AND+%28taxonomy_id%3A4890%29 Pombe is annotated to "ascospore formation" and nidulans to "conidiospore formation", which both have the parent "cellular developmental process" can this term (cellular developmental process) be made do_not_annotate? - these are the children?

author: Antonialock
body:
hmmm,  wonder if "sporulation" (The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a spore over time, from its initiation to the mature structure. ) should be is_a cell development? Then ARBA might pick this term as a common parent instead..

the one term that I'm not sure would fit this is "sporulation resulting in formation of a multicellular or syncytial spore"

AI Overview
A syncytial spore is a multinucleate structure formed either through specialized cell division (septation) or the fusion of germlings (conidial anastomosis tubes) in filamentous fungi. These spores facilitate the creation of a networked, multinucleate mycelium, which is essential for colony establishment, nutrient sharing, and increased adaptability to stressful environments

author: ValWood
body: so it might be OK, this should disappear?
